RULES & SCORING

Transparent tournament rules with configurable scoring.

All teams must check in on time, use registered players and follow organizer instructions. Any intentional abuse, cheating or exploit use can result in disqualification.
Use the assigned room, map and mode. Players must use approved accounts and devices. Match pauses and restarts are controlled by the tournament admin.
Placement points are combined with kill points. The scoring values are stored in JavaScript configuration so an admin can change them without redesigning the interface.
Only registered players may participate. Account sharing, unauthorized substitutes and deliberate disconnect abuse are prohibited.
Cheating, collusion, stream sniping, harassment, match manipulation and repeated rule violations may lead to immediate disqualification.
Prize distribution follows the published results and organizer verification process. Payment details should be handled securely outside the public leaderboard.
